title: 1952 MIT Lincoln Lab audio of DoD saucer briefing

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. So MIT Lincoln Labs, we found out that there was a realtore audio um file from um way back in the 40s. I'm no sorry, it's like 1952 >> where you have a um a senior official with the Department of Defense um briefing scientists at MIT about the about saucers.

plain: There is said to be a real audio recording from 1952 of a senior official from the Department of Defense, the US military's headquarters, briefing scientists about flying saucers at Lincoln Laboratory, a research lab run by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. A US congressman named Eric Burlison says "we found out" about the file, first placing it in the 1940s and then correcting himself to 1952. If so, it would show the military briefing top scientists on saucers early on.
